Name: AT Cartoon Duck Paintings
Author: QueenQuackin
Description:
Some cute and fun duck paintings that are inspired by the cartoons that we all know and love.

The current line up of 9 new texture includes inspiration from
[size=4]The Looney Toons[/size]
Daffy Duck
Bugz Bunny
Elmer Fudd

[size=4]Scooby Doo[/size]
Shaggy
Velma
Scooby
Daphne
Fred

[size=4]Tom and Jerry[/size]

I plan to update with more in the future.
